`input-12mp-single.avif` is a locally generated synthetic AVIF test image, 4000 × 3000 pixels, encoded from a deterministic test chart. It contains no third-party image content.

`input-48mp-grid.avif` is a locally generated synthetic 8000 × 6000 AV1 grid, with 8 × 6 tiles of 1024 × 1024 pixels and a cropped bottom/right edge. It is generated by `scripts/make-tiled-avif-fixture.cpp` using libheif with its AOM AV1 encoder enabled. No third-party image content is used.
